title: Verify: runGuard and guard script unit tests with a fake git runner
summary: Unit tests for runGuard exit codes and the script file's existence and tracking.
description: Tests prove REQ2 using fake runners and a log spy; script presence checked on disk.
acceptance_criteria: Script file exists and imports runGuard.
technical_constraints: Fake runner; file read via node:fs of the script path only

steps.action: Add test 1: run = vi.fn((_a: string[]) => 'node_modules/x.js\0'), log = vi.fn(); expect runGuard(run, log) toBe 1 and log toHaveBeenCalledWith('node_modules/x.js'). Test 2: run returns 'src/a.ts\0'; expect 0 and log not called.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/assertNoTrackedGuard.test.ts -t runGuard

steps.action: Read scripts/assertNoTrackedNodeModules.ts with readFileSync relative to import.meta.dirname and expect it toContain 'runGuard' and 'process.exit'.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/assertNoTrackedGuard.test.ts -t 'guard script'
